definitions.explanation: The use of physical violence against another person. In legal contexts it refers to the crime of using force on someone, and it is sometimes a euphemism for sexual assault.

examples.japanese: {暴行|ぼうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通行人|つうこうにん}→通行人：28570_tsuukounin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暴行|ぼうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。

⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口論|こうろん}→口論：08371_kouron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暴行|ぼうこう}し、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect assaulted the other person after an argument and was arrested by the police.

notes:
Refers to inflicting physical violence on a person. Common in news and legal contexts, and sometimes used as a euphemism for sexual assault.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴行|ぼうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to commit an assault (on someone)
- {暴行|ぼうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be assaulted
- {暴行|ぼうこう}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: an assault case

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧: violence — the general phenomenon of force, whereas {暴行|ぼうこう} is a specific violent act
- ⟦{傷害|しょうがい}→傷害：22910_shougai⟧: bodily injury (as a crime) — an assault that actually causes injury
